create.name: Gayle Wilson
create.bio:
Gayle Wilson is an Australian author and wellbeing coach who writes about the thing families are least allowed to say out loud: “We are sold this notion that family is everything — the be-all and end-all. But what if your family is actually a little bit f*cked up?” Her raw memoir Where the Waves Break: How I Found Myself After Tragedy (2025) walks readers through the darkest corners of family disconnect and dysfunction — undiagnosed mental illness, a sibling’s addiction, and the life-altering tragedy they led to — and then, warts and all, through the quiet of grief into compassion, forgiveness, and the slow rebuilding of herself and her childhood family.

A mum of three with a self-confessed wicked sense of humour and a huge, ambitious heart, Gayle now helps others do what she did: heal themselves and reconnect their families for better and brighter times. Through her coaching programs and workplace wellbeing sessions, she brings the memoir’s hard-earned medicine — that you are not alone in the complexities of family, and that it’s still possible to choose life after the storm — to readers and audiences who need to feel seen before they can begin.

books.title: Where the Waves Break: How I Found Myself After Tragedy
books.author: Gayle Wilson
books.description: A raw, warts-and-all memoir about the family dysfunction few people dare to name: undiagnosed mental illness, a sibling’s addiction, and the life-altering tragedy they led to. Gayle Wilson writes with candour and sharp humour about using the quiet of grief to come back to herself after years of holding everyone else together. Her path through compassion and forgiveness shows other families they are not alone, and that it is possible to choose life after the storm.

courses.title: The Soul Care Healing Method
courses.description: Gayle’s self-paced healing programme of video modules, with lifetime access, for women who feel overwhelmed, exhausted or disconnected from themselves. It is the core method behind her mentoring work and a gentle, go-at-your-own-pace path back to calm and confidence.

courses.title: Confidence Reclaimed
courses.description: A private, application-only 12-month mentorship for high-achieving women who want to restore their energy, confidence and boundaries without burning out. It includes 1:1 coaching calls, voice-message support, expert masterclasses, monthly group calls with wellness experts, an annual in-person retreat, and lifetime access to The Soul Care Healing Method.

courses.title: HER Membership
courses.description: A women’s membership offering monthly live “Deep Dive” video calls with Gayle, the HER Library and access to The Soul Care Healing Method. Higher tiers add extra group calls, weekly momentum sessions and a ticket to the 2027 HER two-day conference. Joining is by waitlist for now.
